nodes.title: Direct API Integration
nodes.summary: This suite of APIs allows direct initiation of CARD, BANK, and USSD transactions without using the Squad Modal, with general environment and authorization details provided.

nodes.title: Direct CARD Payments
nodes.summary: This section details the API suite for merchants to directly collect and charge customer card details, outlining various payment scenarios and test cards.

nodes.title: Charge Card
nodes.summary: This POST endpoint initiates a card transaction by accepting collected card details and other required fields, returning a transaction status that dictates the next authorization step.

nodes.title: Authorize Card Payment
nodes.summary: This POST endpoint authorizes a card payment based on the transaction status from the initial charge, supporting PIN, OTP, or 3DS challenges.

nodes.title: Initiate Direct GTBank Account Debit
nodes.summary: This POST endpoint initiates a direct debit from a GTBank account using the account or phone number, requiring a subsequent validation step for completion.

nodes.title: Validate Direct Bank API Payment
nodes.summary: This POST endpoint is used to authenticate and finalize a direct bank account debit transaction by receiving an OTP or token from the user based on the 'auth_model'.

nodes.title: Initiate USSD Payment
nodes.summary: This POST endpoint initiates a USSD transaction, processing payment details and generating a USSD code for the customer to complete the payment, listing supported banks.

nodes.title: Go Live
nodes.summary: This section provides essential steps for transitioning from the sandbox environment to live production, including URL updates, account registration, KYC completion, and API key replacement.
